critique: The render now has a much better flash-like lifetime: it is visible at 0.01 and fully extinguished by 0.08. Its yellow-orange palette is also closer to a hot ignition than the prior soft orange cloud. However, at the visible frame it remains a compact, nearly circular cluster of large soft discs. It lacks the thumbnail's aggressive directional, starburst-like explosive silhouette, a near-white hot center, and sharper energetic fragments/streaks extending from the muzzle direction.

suggestions.why: Reduce particle feather substantially so the flash resolves into crisper high-energy particles instead of a soft rounded blob.
Increase main particle velocity to push the burst outward into a more explosive directional muzzle-flash silhouette during its short visible lifetime.
Broaden the directional cone enough to form a pointed fan/starburst while retaining a clear forward muzzle direction.
Shift the primary particle color toward intense yellow to create a hotter, closer-to-white-looking flash core against black.
Raise particle opacity so the overlapping center reads as a bright ignition core rather than uniformly translucent orange circles.
